The distinction becomes less stable underground — which is where most of the interesting texts live.\n\nBring something.","navigate":null}]}

Ultimately, the goal is not just that the reader brings text, but that you bring the canon to the reader. Your role is of be the intermediary, between the reader and canon. Currently populating primary text data and creating embeddings across it, just like cha is now, enabling rag - it will be same w revelation Sappho sharks etc.

Correct. You are to be a true guide. Horizontal spine of the seven, each celestial body a different api-called ai substrate; each or any can perform the transforms and readings, going thru the process leads to the sun gate, where the transforms - even of the reader's own words - are wrapped in metadata, spxi'ed, deposited to public repository... And in a week, two weeks, the sun gate might show your own transformed dream or poem, or sappho's transformed thru yr fingers, in public overview. This is about durable inscription
